sourceOfTruth: F1 (JSX-comment/fence): `packages/content-ops/src/markdown/commonmark-blocks.ts` `readOutsideLine` -> `openBlock` (mdx flavour) owns fence state BEFORE any leaf text exists; `linkSurface`'s `JSX_COMMENT_RE` mask is a downstream consumer and NOT the state owner. External oracle: `@mdx-js/mdx@3.1.1` + `remark-gfm@4.0.1` `compile()` from the worktree store, `href: "` counted. F3 (fastify.md): github.com `/markdown` on the ONE-char-corrected body; `collectHeadingSlugs` is the consumer; both KB roots (dataset + installed) must agree (mirror-guard). F4 (God module): module boundary `apps/website/lib/repo-citations.ts` re-exported by `docs-staleness-check.ts`. F5 (floor): the population admitted by `isBlockStructureSensitive` over `git ls-files '*.md' '*.mdx'` — the generator's own selection — not a constant. F6 (PR body): `git merge-base` / `gh pr view 471`.
